class.name: CgameFacialAnimation
class.brief_description: Procedural facial animation on ARKit-style blend shapes.
class.description: [CgameFacialAnimation] computes blend shape weights from an emotion preset (built from FACS action units), additive pain and aggression layers, viseme weights, and deterministic procedural blinks and eye saccades. The output of [method evaluate] is a dictionary from blend shape name (for example [code]jawOpen[/code], [code]mouthSmileLeft[/code], [code]eyeBlinkLeft[/code]) to a weight in [code][0, 1][/code], and can be applied to a [MeshInstance3D] with [method apply_to]. Blinks and saccades depend only on [member seed] and time, so replays are identical. Emotions: [code]neutral[/code], [code]happy[/code], [code]sad[/code], [code]angry[/code], [code]fear[/code], [code]surprise[/code], [code]disgust[/code].

method.name: apply_to
method.description: Writes the weights to the matching blend shapes of [param mesh_instance]. Returns the number of shapes that were found.

method.name: blink_weight
method.description: Returns the eyelid closure in [code][0, 1][/code] at [param time].

method.name: evaluate
method.description: Returns blend shape weights at [param time]. Unknown emotions are ignored.

method.name: gaze_at
method.description: Returns the saccadic gaze offset in [code][-1, 1][/code] on both axes at [param time].

members.member: Strength of the additive aggression layer.
Strength of the additive pain layer.
If [code]true[/code], procedural eye saccades are added.
